email.subject: Quick fix for Rapid Co Plumbing's site
email.body:
Hi Elena,

I looked at Rapid Co Plumbing's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors searching for a plumber in Harbor Falls can't tap to call you directly, and the site doesn't list your hours, so people can't tell if you're open now. The footer also still shows an old copyright year, which can make visitors second-guess if the business is active.

I fix these for local business sites for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
